layout_sources: https://openflyers.com/fr/doc/of4/Mod%C3%A8le-d'import-de-relev%C3%A9-bancaire-CSV-Cr%C3%A9dit-Agricole-avec-point-virgule (ISO-8859-15, semicolon, a header block that starts "Téléchargement du ..." with the holder, a "Solde au ..." line and the period, ended by the line that starts "Date;"; columns Date, Libellé, Débit Euros, Crédit Euros, sometimes Date valeur)
notes: Crédit Agricole en Ligne "Télécharger vos opérations" CSV: a preamble (download date, holder, account, "Solde au" with the balance, the period), a blank line, then "Date;Libellé;Débit euros;Crédit euros;" with a trailing semicolon. Debits and credits in separate columns as positive figures with a comma decimal; the label is a quoted field spread over two lines padded with spaces. ISO-8859-15 (so the € after the balance is byte 0xA4, °/é as in Latin-1), CRLF, newest first. Regional banks (caisses régionales) differ in details; the exact preamble wording, the multi-line labels, the absence of a thousands mark and the file name (CAyyyymmdd_hhmmss.csv) are from memory and not confirmed. The "Solde au 03/11/2026" balance is the closing: the period ends that day.
